note: GISCO's commune vintages (2001-2010) carry Bulgaria's ~5,200 settlements (EKATTE), not its 265 obshtini, so an obshtina-level election resolved at its own vintage lands on a single village: median unit 50 km² against an obshtina average of 419, covering 15% of the country. The obshtina layer first appears in LAU 2017. Only vintages below this floor are raised; later elections still use their own, so post-2017 boundary changes are tracked.

GISCO alternates between publishing Lithuania as its 60 savivaldybės (2001, 2012, 2018 onwards) and as its ~540 seniūnijos (2004-2011, 2014, 2016). An election resolved at a seniūnija vintage lands on one eldership of the municipality that voted: the 2008 map covered 24,289 of 65,300 km2, a median unit of 152 km2 against a municipal average of 1,088. 2012 is the first municipal vintage in the modern code scheme that geo_join_id maps onto.
GISCO's LAU vintages up to 2016 carry North Macedonia's ~1,775 settlements, not its 80 opštini; the municipal layer, in the code scheme of the results, first appears in LAU 2017.
Serbia first appears in GISCO in LAU 2014 (its 168 municipalities and cities, in the code scheme of the results); the 2003-2008 elections are drawn on that vintage.
